name: Sakura Alien
source:
Takagi Haru is a normal university student, with a somewhat abnormal passion for the stars. A member of his university's astronomy club, alongside his friendly upper-classman, Hiyori, Haru was content to watch the stars from afar...

That is, until one night, when a strange girl in a skintight bodysuit lands on top of him. This girl claims to be an alien princess called Ena, on the run from her home planet, Corval, owing to the strict expectations placed upon her by her royal parents.

Ena, a huge fan of Earth, and of earthling culture in general, is over the moon when she meets Haru. She's convinced that their abrupt meeting was written in the stars, and claims herself as Haru's future bride.

Ena's determined to make Haru fall in love with her, so she can marry him and live out the rest of her days on Earth - but Hiyori has feelings for Haru, too, and she also ends up confessing to him.

What will Haru do, now he has two pretty girls vying for his attention, and a fugitive alien princess living in his apartment? He doesn't know, but one thing is certain: his life will never be the same again!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
高木春是一名普通大学生，对明星有着某种异常的热情。作为大学天文俱乐部的成员，Haru和他友好的学长Hiyori一起，满足于从远处观看星星……

直到有一天晚上，一个穿着紧身衣的陌生女孩落在了他身上。这个女孩自称是一位名叫埃娜的外星公主，由于她的皇室父母对她寄予了严格的期望，她从她的家乡科瓦尔星球逃亡。

埃娜是地球和地球文化的超级粉丝，当她遇到哈鲁时，她欣喜若狂。她确信他们的突然相遇是在星星中写下的，并声称自己是哈鲁未来的新娘。

惠那决心让哈鲁爱上她，这样她就可以嫁给他并在地球上度过余生——但日和也对哈鲁有感情，她最终也向他表白了。

现在，哈鲁有两个漂亮女孩争夺他的注意力，而他的公寓里住着一位逃亡的外星公主，他会怎么做？他不知道，但有一件事是确定的：他的生活将不再一样！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592640/]Steam[/url]]
